name: Go Dub Yourself!
summary:
Go Dub Yourself! is an interactive party game where players re-voice video clips using on-screen timing markers. Players can play straight, go off-script, or improvise, with flexible scoring options including auto-scoring, player judging, and chat voting. Key features include an integrated voice changer with 18 choices, party tournaments, a dedicated Studio mode, dark mode, and Steam achievements.

Using the Clip Studio tool, users can import any video, set timing lines, assign characters, and convert clips into playable dubbing packs. Content can be exported locally or uploaded directly to the Steam Workshop. The game supports local co-op for up to 8 players on a single machine and online multiplayer for up to 12 players via simple room codes with built-in voice chat.

The game includes no pre-packaged copyrighted media; players are responsible for supplying their own video files and ensuring they have the rights to any content they import or share.
